title: PokeAurora Oficial
description: Official PokeAurora modpack. Includes all required mods, resources, and optimizations to provide the complete multiplayer Pokémon adventure experience on the server.
body:
# PokeAurora

PokeAurora is the official modpack for the PokeAurora server, designed to provide players with the complete intended gameplay experience.

The modpack includes Cobblemon, performance optimizations, quality-of-life improvements, custom resources, and all required content used by the server. Every included mod has been selected to improve stability, compatibility, and overall gameplay while ensuring a seamless multiplayer experience.

By installing this modpack, players gain access to all features and resources required to join the server without additional setup. The pack is regularly maintained to remain compatible with server updates and custom content.

## What does this modpack include?

* Cobblemon and its required dependencies.
* Performance and stability improvements.
* Quality-of-life enhancements.
* Custom resources and configurations used by the server.
* Pre-configured settings for easy installation and play.

## Why download this modpack?

This modpack provides the easiest and most reliable way to play on the PokeAurora server. All required content is included and configured, reducing setup time and ensuring compatibility with the server's features and future updates.

## Important Information

This modpack is intended for use on the PokeAurora server and contains content specifically configured for that environment. For the best experience, it is recommended to use the modpack without removing or modifying included components.
